name: openenlink
description: Connect to Enlink campus networks through a local SOCKS proxy.
author: Ge Gao (Snowflyt) <gaoge011022@gmail.com>

scripts.postinstall: node -e "import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; import fs from 'node:fs'; const directory = 'node_modules/tcpip'; const metadata = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(directory + '/package.json', 'utf8')); if (metadata.version !== '0.4.0') throw new Error('Review the tcpip half-close fix for this version'); const file = directory + '/dist/index.js'; const source = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8'); const quote = String.fromCharCode(34); const broken = 'this.#o(),this.#r?.error(new Error(' + quote + 'tcp connection closed' + quote + '))'; fs.writeFileSync(file, source.replaceAll(broken, 'this.#o()')); if (fs.existsSync('.git')) execFileSync('git', ['config', 'core.hooksPath', '.githooks']);"
